target: fixed R_mix341 semantic operations, proposed exact CANON2 root-only/fixed-DEF-facet grammar
hypothesis: For any legal CANON2 derivation and any auxiliary-bit gauge, positional DEF facet IDs can be permuted to give an accepted source-exact proof with identical q

proof.source_sat: F=(x)&(not x)&(y or not y) is UNSAT; F+=(x)&(y or not y) is SAT

resources.serialized_bits: O(E) output for input E-bit certificate, given canonical fixed fields and identical identifier magnitudes; O(N+E) including external source
resources.construction: polynomial time in N+E with dense string parsing and sparse memoized coordinate flips
resources.verification: separate polynomial time in N+E, not free
resources.peak_space: O(N+E) buffered; no FLMV native tape bound

limitations: CANON2 is a new proposed byte completion, not proven uniquely fixed by historical R341 prose
No raw bytes and exact parsing of arbitrary legal native exported-wire or private LOCAL gates
No polynomial B3 bridge, no computational hardness inference
q=17 is an upper trace, not a certified optimum
